
```{r}

```

```{r}
key <- key |>
  select(sample, record_id) |>
  dplyr::rename(pt_id = record_id)

write.csv(key, "/fs/ess/PAS1695/projects/mitox/ultra-filtering/data/ultra-filtered/sample-key.csv", row.names = F)
```
